corrections.reason: The final letter on L01 is 1st-order አ (forming አስፈሪዳት across the line break), not 6th-order እ.
The third character in ስፈሪዳት is 3rd-order ሪ (matching አስፈሪዳት on the previous page), misread as ፈ.
The printed glyph has the 5th-order loop ሄ (ሄደ), not 3rd-order ሂ (ሂደ).
Both the printed 2nd-order stroke and Ge'ez plural subject agreement (ፈሪሳውያን ወሰዱቃውያን) show ኀሠሡ rather than singular ኀሠሠ.
Canonical Ge'ez enclitic particle ዮምሰኒ ('even today') has 3rd-order ኒ (ሰኒ), visible in the image rather than 5th-order ኔ.
Classical Ge'ez construct noun for 'leaven of' is ብኁዐ (2nd-order ኁ, matching እምብኁዖሙ in L34), which is visible on the right leg of the glyph.
